verdict.rationale: Raygun publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for its v3 API at api.raygun.com, linked from its docs, with a hosted Swagger UI loading the same spec. The probe 404s were on raygun.com candidate paths, not the API origin, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of the spec's use, and discoverability at a conventional well-known path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
